title: Seymour’s dyadic packing conjecture
formal: For every ideal clutter C on a finite ground set E and every capacity vector \(w\in\mathbb Z_{\ge0}^{E}\), does the packing linear program \[\max\{\textstyle\sum_{S\in C}y_S:y\ge0,\ \sum_{S\ni e}y_S\le w_e\ (e\in E)\}\] have an optimum all of whose coordinates are dyadic rationals?
definitions:
A clutter is a finite family of nonempty subsets of E such that no distinct member contains another. Its incidence matrix A has one row per member and one column per element. It is ideal if its covering polyhedron \(Q=\{x\in\mathbb R^E:x\ge0,Ax\ge\mathbf1\}\) equals the convex hull of its integral points, equivalently all its vertices are integral. The empty family is permitted and gives a trivial zero packing. The exclusion of an empty member ensures the covering system is feasible and packing is bounded.

The displayed packing is the dual of \(\min\{w^{\mathsf T}x:x\in Q\}\). A nonnegative dyadic rational is a number a/2^k for integers a,k≥0. The exponents may differ between coordinates and are not bounded in advance. The target is exact optimality, not approximate packing or half-integral packing with denominator at most two. No efficient construction or bound on denominators is asked.
answer_criterion: Give a complete Lean-checked proof of a dyadic optimum for every ideal clutter and integral capacity vector, or an ideal clutter and capacities whose optimal face contains no dyadic packing. A finite-denominator bound stronger than dyadicness is not required.
context: The conjecture asks how far primal integrality controls denominators in optimal dual packings. Total dual dyadicness permits arbitrary powers of two rather than requiring integral dual solutions.
why: The conjecture asks whether integral covering geometry forces a special arithmetic form of optimal fractional packing.

import_provenance.original_statement: For every ideal clutter and nonnegative integral element capacities, does the dual of its minimum-weight covering LP have an optimal packing whose coordinates are dyadic rationals, with denominators powers of 2? This asks whether integrality of the covering polyhedron forces a uniform arithmetic structure on optimal fractional packings.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: The 2025 dyadic-packing theorem for dijoins settles a special case, not all ideal clutters; the 2026 local-dyadic work also treats a weaker conjecture and special cases. See Guenin’s publication list: https://www.math.uwaterloo.ca/~bguenin/papers.html.
